title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Knit Pay Knit…
description: Knit Pay versions up to 9.6.4.0 are affected by a stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of other users. The CVSS 3.1 score is 7.1, indicating a high severity impact with potential confidentiality, integrity, and availability consequences. No patch or remediation information is provided in the source data.
